notes: κυκλωσάντων → as the disciples stood round about him heads on round, the meaning-bearing complement of the support frame rather than the supplied stood; heading on about is the near alternative and either keeps the head inside that complement.
τῇ ἐπαύριον → on the morrow gives on the to the article headed on the, rule 17 choosing the determiner where a case-inflected article becomes on the.
εἰσῆλθεν keeps only entered, the preverb εἰσ- being answered by the expressed εἰς under rule 106.
